parameters.query: SELECT c.id, c.email, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.company, c.client_id, c.lead_score, c.created_at, d.deal_value, d.assigned_to, (SELECT MAX(la.created_at) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id) as last_activity, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as activities_30d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.created_at BETWEEN NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days' AND NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as activities_prev_30d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.activity_type = 'email_opened' AND la.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as opens_30d, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.activity_type = 'email_opened' AND la.created_at BETWEEN NOW() - INTERVAL '60 days' AND NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days') as opens_prev_30d FROM contacts c LEFT JOIN deals d ON d.contact_id = c.id AND d.stage = 'closed_won' WHERE c.lead_status = 'customer' ORDER BY c.id
